items.performers: Gidon Kremer (violin), Boston Symphony Orchestra, Charles Dutoit (conductor)
items.label: Deutsche Grammophon 427 336-2
items.note: This violin concerto takes Bach’s royal theme apart, removing notes from each end, then rebuilds it and states it backwards at the close. Kremer, the dedicatee, plays with Dutoit and the Boston Symphony in the recording that won Gubaidulina the 1989 Koussevitzky International Recording Award.

items.performers: Boris Pergamenschikow (cello), Elsbeth Moser (bayan), Münchener Kammerorchester, Christoph Poppen (conductor)
items.label: ECM New Series 1775
items.note: Cello, bayan (the Russian button accordion) and strings set Christ’s last sayings from the Cross. Moser and Pergamenschikow blend the two solo instruments against the strings of the Munich Chamber Orchestra.

items.performers: Anne-Sophie Mutter (violin), London Symphony Orchestra, Valery Gergiev (conductor)
items.recorded: February 2008, AIR Studios, Lyndhurst Hall, London
items.label: Deutsche Grammophon 477 7450
items.note: The orchestra has no violins apart from the soloist; its string section consists of fifteen violas, twelve cellos and nine double basses. Mutter, the concerto’s dedicatee and first soloist, made its first recording with Gergiev and the London Symphony Orchestra.
